curation.rule: pstack's playbooks lead the workflow (planning, TDD, verification, review, decisions, parallel work); ECC supplies language, framework, tool and domain specifics. An ECC skill that only restates a pstack workflow is left out, and references to it in the skills kept point at pstack's counterpart (`leads`). Upstream's own exclusions are in CURATION.md.

tdd-workflow.why: generic red-green-refactor loop; pstack-tdd and the bug-fix and feature playbooks lead. Language TDD skills (django-tdd, laravel-tdd, springboot-tdd, quarkus-tdd, *-testing) stay.

verification-loop.why: generic verify-the-session loop written for Claude Code; pstack's prove-it-works leads. Framework verification loops (django-, laravel-, quarkus-, springboot-verification) stay.

change-impact.why: pre-change impact analysis; pstack's blast-radius covers it and proves the claim by running code.

codebase-onboarding.why: explains an unfamiliar codebase and writes a starter CLAUDE.md; pstack's how skill and investigation playbook lead.

benchmark-optimization-loop.why: measured optimization loop; pstack's hillclimb and perf-issue playbooks lead.

blueprint.why: multi-session construction plan; pstack's multi-phase-plan playbook and figure-it-out lead.

intent-driven-development.why: acceptance criteria before implementation; the feature playbook and figure-it-out lead.

agentic-engineering.why: eval-first decomposition and model routing; poteto-mode itself.

ai-first-engineering.why: team operating model for AI-written code; poteto-mode and its principles.

agent-self-evaluation.why: self-rating after every task contradicts prove-it-works (evidence over self-assessment) and ships hook integration.

parallel-execution-optimizer.why: parallel lane planning; pstack's swarm skill and the feature playbook's throughput checkpoint lead.

ecc-council.why: four-voice decision council; pstack's interrogate (multi-model adversarial) leads.

dev-team.why: simulated role personas debating one problem; interrogate and arena lead.

conventional-commit-review.why: commit message drafting; repo rules, technical-writing and the opening-a-pr playbook lead.

plan.why: /plan is stock omp's plan mode and OMPdesk's Plan command.

curation.commands: Prompt commands run only when the user types them, so they never compete with pstack's routing (an invoked command outranks the pstack section); all 24 are kept.
curation.hidden: Every kept skill has disable-model-invocation: true (read as skill://<name>); only the generated index skill `ecc` is listed to the model.
